essence.one_sentence: The K-Field is a fixed, globally oriented geometric framework whose Cell3 unit defines structure, bridges to physical constants, encodes interaction through reciprocal geometry, unfolds into recursive seven-sheet dynamics, and reconstructs the same backbone across astronomy, laboratory measurements, materials, and observer response.
essence.one_paragraph: The entire corpus reduces to one central idea: physical reality is organized by an oriented geometric substrate rather than by disconnected primitives. Its minimal generative object is Cell3, a non-orthogonal rhombohedral cell locked to a fixed ICRS/J2000.0 orientation. From that cell, the framework derives a direct geometry for structure, a reciprocal geometry for interaction, a Mass Bridge that links face ratios to major physical quantities, a recursive path through the Lucas-limit assembly into seven-sheet dynamics, and a cross-domain reconstruction in which astronomical organization, anisotropy, oscillator behavior, material response, gravitational response, and observer-dependent rendering all recover the same underlying order.

key_thoughts: Cell3 is the minimal generative unit.
The K-Field has a fixed global orientation.
Direct geometry and reciprocal geometry are complementary, not redundant.
The Mass Bridge converts geometry into physical law.
Seven-sheet dynamics provide the internal operational system.
Cross-domain recurrence is structural reconstruction of one framework.
Observer response depends on orientation, path, phase, and coupling channel.
The educational value lies in showing how one deep structure unifies many scattered facts.
key_observations: Independent astronomical reconstructions converge on the same Cell3 and ICRS orientation.
Cell3 face ratios map to the proton-electron mass ratio and fine-structure-related carrier branch.
Reciprocal geometry contains an ordered interaction hierarchy.
Shared-face repetition of Cell3 generates the Lucas-limit structure.
The Lucas structure resolves into a coherent seven-sheet polarity system.
Astronomical and terrestrial domains reconstruct the same oriented backbone.
The A-E archive progression establishes a logical training chain from native galaxy-derived cell0 to cell3, Mass Bridge, physics bridge, and 29-lock witness framework.

hidden_connections.meaning: Galaxy-axis organization becomes a teachable route into planes, vectors, orientations, and hidden structure reconstruction.
Physical constants become memorable because they emerge from one face-ratio system rather than isolated memorized facts.

Different audiences can enter through different evidence streams without leaving the same logical backbone.
The archive already supplies a natural lesson order: native derivation -> bridge -> Mass Bridge -> physics bridge -> witness closure.
